check_file_size.short_help: Token efficiency triage: file size analysis.
check_file_size.long_help:
Analyzes source files and lists them by size (line count), classifying them by configurable thresholds. Useful for identifying token consumption bottlenecks before feeding a repository to an AI.

Usage:
    ./check_file_size.py <path> [options]

Examples:
    ./check_file_size.py ./src
    ./check_file_size.py ./src --warn 300 --error 500 --critical 1000
    ./check_file_size.py ./src --top 20
    ./check_file_size.py ./src --exclude node_modules,dist,build
    ./check_file_size.py ./src --ext .py --ext .js
